notes: Ulinzi baada ya kufutwa (Factory Reset Protection): simu iliyofutwa kwa recovery, Odin au fastboot inasimama kwenye setup ikiomba akaunti ya Google ya HOOP iliyowekwa kwenye Settings (DEVICE_FRP_ACCOUNT_IDS); inaondolewa simu ikiachiwa. / After a wipe (recovery, Odin, fastboot) the setup wizard now demands the HOOP Google account named in Settings; cleared on release.
